comparison.objective: Candidate removes and recovers four HELICOIL tangs; record unloads two books from one supporting hand before parking that hand.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires precision tool alignment, bimanual hammering, and tiny-object recovery; record requires maintaining support during hand-to-hand unloading and stable book placement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four clean fractures, undamaged retained components, all tangs in a tray, tool release, and stability; record requires both books preserved and placed flat before the supporting hand is parked, with no mandated sequence.
comparison.reason: Load-preserving handoff and placement are meaningfully different from controlled impact fracture.
